chunks: Abān ibn ʿUthmān narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man was taken captive by the Romans, and the month of Ramadan was not established for him, and he did not know which month it was.

He عليه السلام said: He should fast for a month, estimating and calculating. If the month that he fasted was before the month of Ramadan, it does not suffice for him; but if it was after the month of Ramadan, it suffices for him.

key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the obligatory month of sawm (fasting)
key_terms.لَمْ يُجْزِئْهُ: it would not suffice for him
key_terms.يَتَوَخَّى: he seeks the most likely estimate

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they miss knowing Ramadan while in captivity and can only estimate the month?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a person who was unable to determine the time of Ramadan due to captivity and uncertainty. He must fast one month based on his best estimation and calculation. If his fast occurred before Ramadan, it does not count; if it occurred after Ramadan, it is valid.
